sourceObservations.criterion: Immutable CLI inputs, output/journal identity, scratch selection, and resume selection are admitted before START
sourceObservations.detail: Parsing rejects duplicate, unknown, missing, malformed, and conflicting options; the command requires canonical paths and an empty mode-0700 output, creates private inputs/journal directories, and publishes no-replace invocation.json with directory identities before intent preparation. The invocation binds the exact argv and checkpoint threshold and rechecks identities.

sourceObservations.criterion: Mismatched artifacts and unavailable containment inputs fail before execution authorization
sourceObservations.detail: Preflight checks disjoint canonical roots, the selected engine and archive byte identities, the profile checkpoint bound, bundled deployment/tool paths, exact artifact roles, invocation bytes, and dedicated scratch admission before execute() can reach a contained START.

sourceObservations.criterion: Production intent is derived from retained profile and bundled deployment references
sourceObservations.detail: StableControlFile snapshots retain the profile closure, engine/source/tool inputs, planner identity/version, reconstruction policy and digests. Intent binding compares every required role and budget against the retained profile and embeds the derived planner policy; it does not use hosted fixture identity records.

fixtureObservations.detail: Authored temporary binary/profile/archive files and private output/scratch directories cover option conflicts, canonical directory replacement, exact checkpoint selection, mismatched binary rejection, and unreachable checkpoint rejection before staging or leasing.

The current deployment reference fixture checks ordered BOOT identities and defensive manifest bytes; authored wrong-engine, linked-input, repeated-root, invalid-engine, and repeated-staging cases remain empty before publication.

The exact retained profile is GCC 16.2.0 for x86_64-linux-gnu with exporter version 10, Ghidra 12.1.3, deterministic-module-planner v1, and explicit export/planner ceilings used by the code references above.

The only real-engine fixture requires separately provisioned installation, profile, archive, cc1/lto1 binaries, four scratch mounts, and an evidence root; its comparison remains benchmarkAccepted=false and releaseEligible=false.
